rows.note: The bucket resets to 20 s at the prompt and 45 words add 15 s at T + 20: SUP to T + 35. Nothing to read until the edit at T + 50 while the turn runs, the turn the rules say a person started.
The 16-line edit adds 120 s: SUP to the stop at T + 100, then READ to the window's end at T + 120. No prompt follows, so the 70 s left at 20:20:00 lie after the window.

notes: WP-FX8's (b): a script sends Claude Code a prompt every 300 s through tmux send-keys, which writes to the pty, while the person plays a game in a browser. GNOME on Wayland gives pairtime no focus, so the only os.focus says app_class unknown, and SM 2.2 rule 6's focus test passes for every session: the game's input makes each scripted prompt human_typed (SM 2.2, 2.5).
1,140 of the 1,200 s are credited, every one at level C with focus_unknown, and none at level A or B. The X11 twin, b-pty-game-x11, has the same acts with the browser in front and credits nothing.

Each cycle: the prompt's 180 s lead, SUP 85, READ 20 and X.agent_only 15 while the turn runs with nothing new on screen. In the first three cycles the 70 s left in the bucket at T + 120 are never read, because the next prompt's lead beats the bucket (SM 3.3 rule 2) and the next prompt resets it. The last cycle's 70 s lie after the window.
